97.Connect the solenoid valve harness connectors to the valve 
body connectors and the fluid temperature sensor 
connector.
98.Install the manual control shaft detent and tighten the bolt to 
the specified torque.
Tightening torque: 6 ± 1 N⋅m (52 ± 9 in-lb)
99.Apply a 2 mm (0.08 inch) diameter bead of sealant 
(MITSUBISHI Genuine Part number MD974421 or 
equivalent) to the valve body cover in the area shown.
NOTE: Be sure to install the case quickly while the sealant is 
wet (with 15 minutes).
NOTE: After installation, keep the sealed area away from 
the oil for approximately one hour.
100.Install the valve body cover, and then tighten its mounting 
bolts to the specified torque.
Tightening torque: 11 ± 1 N⋅m (95 ± 9 in-lb)
